tei:div.tei:p: "$ (245)༄༅// ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

(246)༄༅// oṃ swa sti// rgyal ba mchog rnams kun gyi dngos// lhan skyes dga' chen he ru ka /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor la// btud nas da yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad gcig gis// rigs lnga'i lha tshogs byon par gyur// bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang du gsol// ces gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing khrus byas pas/ dbang bzhi thob/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes myang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta phā tsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi sems nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes spros pa mtha' dag gis dben pa'o/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag /rang skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ 'og phyogs su chad/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor (247)du gyur/ hūm̐ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par gtams pa/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu bzhu ste rwa gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing*/ phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur// snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum/

skyabs yul de rnams bdag gi mdun du byon te/ 'od zer rang gi lus la phog pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang skyabs yul dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems (248)dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gnyis kyis nang mchod dang gsang mchod phul/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams gnyis su med cing dmigs su med pa'o/ /ces de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshogs zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las ri rgyal lhun po shar shel/ byang gser/ nub pad+ma rā ga /lho baiḍūr+ya las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi dang ldan zhing lcogs brgyad kyis brgyan pa gru bzhi pa ste/ 'byung bzhi ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o// de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/

lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa dang*/ pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'o// de'i steng du rang sems zla ba dmar skya la gnas pa'i hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus te thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su (249)gyur pa las brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang*/ ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang*/ ska rags dang mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dpa' bo'i dar dbyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa skums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing*/

g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing (250)ga /byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing*/ mi ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o// mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa thod pas kha brgyan pa dang bcas pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ gis shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo dang mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/

rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ lā ma la don yod grub pa/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med// gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ cung zad rgyas pa la spro na lha dbang bskur ba'i skabs 'dir byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang a bhi ṣe ka 'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang yod pa ltar spro na bya'o// de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs kyang rung mod kyi/ (251) lag len la de lta bu gtso bor mi mdzad do// des na bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ gzhir gnas kyi dam rdzas dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/ lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste thim/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te bdud rtsi myangs pas lha thams cad bde bas mnyes par bsam/ bar 'dir rdzogs rim rtsa 'khor lo bzhi pa'i gtum mo dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ste yig rnying las shes bar bya'o// de bzhin du yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ṭā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying ngo*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags so// zhes ci nus su bzla/ gtor chog dang 'brel ba yin na skabs 'dir gtor ma btang ba yin na'ang*/ sgrub thabs tsam sgom pa la skabs 'dir gtor ma nges par dgos pa ma yin pas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu byas te thun mtshams la 'jug go /de yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu lha mo bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi rang la thim/ yum yang yab kyi thugs kar thim/ dpal he ru ka yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang he ru (252)ka'i sku gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐// kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob ste// 'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa// byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// spyod pa de gnyis bdag spyod shog /ces dge ba bsngo ba'o// gtor ma btang bar 'dod na/ legs par bshams te/ /sum+bha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ yaṃ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i/ ā las ka pā la de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ na go ku da ha las mi ba glang khyi rta glang chen te sha lnga/ dbus dang mtshams bzhir mu bi ra shu ma las/ chu sman rdul khu pa klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga'i thad kyi steng rnams su hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la zla ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐/

de'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo bo mthur du blta ba/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge bco lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum du byas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i rtse mor hūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la thim/ zla ba yi ge gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas dkrugs pas thams cad zhu ste dam rdzas dang gnyis su med par gyur pas gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ha ho hrīḥ lan mang du brjod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /rang gi mdun du 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pas phyogs thams cad nas bskor ba grub par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ phyogs bcu (253)dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes 'khor lo'i rnam par byon pa rnams dam tshig 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mgron bskyed pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī i dam pa liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge bdun pa dang*/ bai ro tsa nī dang mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan lngas 'bul te ye shes lha la mchod pa'o/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ ub+dā da/ a pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da yaḥ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/

pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar ta yā sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye sa hā yi kā bha wan+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dur khrod na gnas pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da ba 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa ag+ni san+ni bhā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ par shu pā shod+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra dzi nam+ba ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha ka ra ba pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra bā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+yā pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri hūm̐ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+rā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka rī nai tra bh+ra ma ṇi huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhe ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma s+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas// khyed la mchod cing bstod pa (254)yis// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med= zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol lo/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol/ /ces pas bzod par gsol lo/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes mgron gshegs gsol bya/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med par// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi// lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab/ /legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa// bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ /dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun// bdag gir yongs su bzung med par// sems can ma lus kun don du// chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ /ces dge ba byang chub tu bsngo// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgongs don gang*// blo dman rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir// ngag 'don cung zad bsdebs pa yi// dge bas 'gro kun grol gyur cig /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ maṅga laṃ/// /
